hypothesis: A confirmed Gartley or Bat XABCD pattern may predict a reversal after transaction costs. Compare entry immediately after D confirmation with entry after 30% retracement of AD, and compare target/stop with a 20-bar timed exit.

research_provenance.implementation: mechanical adaptation, not the paid/proprietary UltimateX output
research_provenance.source_claim: The author scans confirmed recursive ZigZag pivots XABCD using Fibonacci ranges and separately marks awaiting-entry and in-trade patterns. Exact private ratio tables, recursive pivot engine and historical alert stream are unavailable; this experiment uses one confirmed ZigZag level and explicit standard Gartley/Bat bounds.

availability_lag: D pivot is available only wing completed bars after its center; signal at confirmation close; fill at next open.
signal_semantics: Per-stock long or short pattern event. Bullish X-low/A-high/B-low/C-high/D-low or bearish inverse. Each XABCD tuple can trigger at most one entry.
evaluation_unit: Independent per-stock account, one common parameter setting; not a multi-stock portfolio return.

mechanisms: detect: signal on confirmed D pivot
retrace30: first completed close reaching 30% of AD reversal after D confirmation, within 20 bars
entry_design.confirmation: Pivots require wing=5 or 8 bars on both sides and at least 2% swing; Gartley and Bat ratios in signal code with 8% tolerance on point ratios. Reject a pattern if stop at X or 61.8% AD target was touched between D center and entry decision, because it is no longer awaiting entry.
not_applicable: exact UltimateX state replay without proprietary alert data

mechanisms: tp: target at 61.8% of AD reversal or invalidation beyond X; time limit 40 bars
time20: close after 20 completed bars or invalidation beyond X
exit_design.decision_time: completed bar close, next open exit
exit_design.same_bar_order: No intrabar stop/target fill assumed; if stop and target both touched in one completed bar, mark stop first and exit next open.

parameter_rationale: Wing 8 is author's documented default; wing 5 checks sensitivity. 8% ratio tolerance is documented default. Entry 0.3 and target 0.618 follow documented defaults, but their bases are explicitly adapted to AD. Gartley/Bat are two common classic types; other families are untested, not silently implied.
baseline: One 25% long buy-and-hold position on same stock and timeframe, next-open fill.
signal_rule: Confirmed XABCD Gartley or Bat pattern triggers detect entry on D confirmation or awaits a 30% AD retracement close for up to 20 bars. Signal at close, next-open fill. Exit at completed-bar target/stop or after 20 bars, next-open fill.
execution_timing: Completed-bar observation and decision; next-open execution; 25% of equity per independent stock account.
holding_period: Up to 20 or 40 bars depending on exit
cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
selection: Rank early history across all variants; inspect the >10% policy threshold and >20% user target on all settings; do not interpret seen late history as independent holdout.
limitations: Private UltimateX source and historical alert stream unavailable; this is an explicit proxy
Corporate actions and short borrowing not included
